hooks.name: Remind to update manifest version
hooks.description: When committing on a feature/* or bugfix/* branch, prompts the user to confirm they have updated the manifest.json version.

action.command: branch=$(git -C /Users/melanga/Documents/Projects/climate-timer-integration rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if echo "$branch" | grep -qE '^(feature|bugfix)/'; then input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | grep -q '"git commit"'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"You are committing on a feature/bugfix branch. Have you updated the version in custom_components/climate_timer/manifest.json?"}}'; fi; fi
